content_sections.heading: ACTREC Tendering Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
ACTREC Tendering Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Tendering Engineer: Diploma or Graduate in any stream from a recognized university. Minimum 4 years of relevant experience for Diploma holders and 3 years for Graduate holders. Candidate should be well versed with tendering process encompassing preparing of tender documents, handling ON LINE (e-tender portal) and OFF LINE tenders, co-ordinating Pre-Bid meetings, opening of tenders, preparing initial comparative statements, arrangements for presentations and committee meetings etc. Candidate must be familiar with latest computer applications and AutoCad.

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Tendering Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
ACTREC Tendering Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ACTREC Tendering Engineer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the ACTREC recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the ACTREC recruitment is Tendering Engineer. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Tendering Engineer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Tendering Engineer post as per the official notification released by ACTREC.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Tendering Engineer role?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Diploma or Graduate degree in any stream from a recognized university to be eligible for the Tendering Engineer position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum experience required for the Tendering Engineer position?
faq.answer: For Diploma holders, a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience is required. For Graduate holders, 3 years of relevant experience is necessary.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Tendering Engineer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Tendering Engineer post is 33 years. This limit may be relaxed based on the candidate's experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Tendering Engineer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of ₹30,000/- per month, based on their experience.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for the Tendering Engineer position at ACTREC?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attend a Walk-in Interview. They must report at the specified venue with all required original documents and self-attested copies.

faq.question: Q8. What is the date and venue for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held on 30th September 2026 at Ground Floor, Pushp Building, TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai- 410210.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their Bio-data, recent passport size photograph, scanned copies of Aadhar Card, PAN CARD, and ORIGINAL and Self Attested copies of qualification mark sheets, certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the Tendering Engineer recruitment at ACTREC.
